method: Read-only PowerPoint export of every slide with a product pending-ocr visual block at 1600x900, followed by full-slide visual inspection against the product extraction unit index. Exported images remain in ignored quarantine. Classification is a triage note, not a saved product review verdict.

triage.observation: Membership counts and standards-process stages are encoded in infographic shapes; raw title alone is insufficient.
Historic membership line chart has dated trend and axis values; do not infer exact points from the thumbnail.
Dense 802.11 amendment timeline embeds labels and rates; page 5 Docling bbox warning makes automated coordinates unsuitable.
Robot photograph illustrates the radio-technology topic list; list labels are separate visible text.
Puzzle and arrow graphic carries four UHR theme labels and a work-beyond-11be relationship.
Dated 6 GHz regulatory map and legend carry country-level status; do not use for current regulation claims or exact country answers without a separate map review.
House illustration has small explanatory text and sensing zones beyond the main bullets.
Eight labeled sensing use-case images; several captions are source facts and require object-level checking.
MAC randomization history is a dated timeline with platform/version captions.
Client-steering diagram includes AP messages and traffic direction beyond the adjacent bullet list.
Privacy-of-password illustration shows an example transformation and AES-SIV stages.
Three use-case photographs add no verified numeric performance claim to the positioning bullets.
Application photographs include small embedded range text; cannot classify all four objects as decoration.
Frequency/wavelength diagram has numeric scales; draft questions currently rely on the separate body text only.
Optical communication cartoon does not supply the selected 400–600 nm, 1200–1600 nm or WDM facts; those are visible in the main text block.
Credited cryptography stock illustration adds no selected technical fact to the bullet list.
Vehicle-network architecture diagram labels components and links beyond the AUTO TIG bullets.
Unified channel-model schematic labels inputs, three propagation bands, CUDA acceleration and outputs.
AI/ML beam-sector diagram labels possible observations and actions beyond the main bullets.

draftQuestionImpact: Slides 20 and 22 text blocks were previously matched to the visible originals. Slide 22 illustration is visually illustrative, but the full source still has unresolved visual blocks and no approved product-tree citation.
remaining: Review each of the 39 original visual objects with bound candidate/image hashes and explicit saved verdicts; preserve material chart, map and diagram information or reject unsupported uses before document registration. Then verify product tree read and user-visible citations. This triage cannot authorize Gold or publication.
